entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments:
Jehovah, as the King who reigns in Zion, is to be feared and obeyed by all. 
 
  Let the people tremble; let all nations tremble before his majesty, and submit themselves to him. 
 
  Between the cherubim; that overshadowed the ark.  This was the most holy place, from which God manifested his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments:
Name; to praise God's name, is to praise his infinite perfections as manifested to men; all these his name comprehends. 
 
The holiness of God forms a just ground for loving, worshipping, and obeying him.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: All God's attributes are in harmony with each other.  His omnipotence is the omnipotence of infinite righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: Moses--among his priests; Moses was of the family which God selected for the priesthood, and in the institution of the Jewish ritual he performed some priestly functions, as that of consecrating Aaron and his sons with sacrifices.

Samuel among them that call upon his name; the meaning of this verse is, Moses and Aaron and Samuel among his priests who called on his name.  All three belonged to the priestly order, and are mentioned as eminent examples of men who called on God in intercessory prayer for his people. 
 
Jehovah has in every age been a prayer hearing God, and all who call upon him in spirit and in truth receive a gracious answer.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments:
Inventions; sinful deeds, as that of making the golden calf. 
 
Though Jehovah forgives the penitent, he often chastises them for their sins.
